name: Grade 7 IT Summative: Robotics Parts
description: Ten core first-trimester words for the Grade 7 robotics vocabulary table.

words.definition: A small robot used to learn robotics and coding.
words.example: The team programmed the mBot to drive through the maze.

words.definition: The physical parts of a computer or robot.
words.example: The wheels, sensors, and control board were the robot hardware.

words.definition: Programs that tell a computer or robot what to do.
words.example: The mBlock software sent the movement program to the robot.

words.definition: The frame that holds robot parts together.
words.example: The chassis held the wheels, motor, and control board together.

words.definition: A part that makes movement by turning or spinning.
words.example: The motor turned faster when the student increased the speed value.

words.definition: A part that detects information from the environment.
words.example: The ultrasonic sensor helped the robot notice an obstacle.

words.definition: A small light that a program can control.
words.example: The LED flashed green when the robot reached a checkpoint.

words.definition: A part that makes a sound.
words.example: The buzzer played a short sound after the robot completed the route.

words.definition: The board that controls the robot parts.
words.example: The controller received the uploaded instructions from the computer.

words.definition: The main board that connects and controls robot parts.
words.example: The control board connected the sensor, motor, LED, and buzzer.
